title: Every Slam DOUBLES The Locks 🔒
description:
In our building, closing a door doubles its locks, and the locks never come off. So every front door on our floor stands open, and the hall smells like six dinners.

I've never closed a door in my life. My big sister Jade slams them. We have one bathroom, we both need it at 7:15, and she always gets there first.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment SLAM if someone in your house slams every door.
